title: Round manifest (rtm-roundmanifest-1.0)
description: The round's roster, written by the leader view with the assignment files: every enumerator, their households (IDs only), the rule and seed, and each assignment file's fingerprint. The merge checks every export against it. It holds no names or phone numbers. File name: {program}_R{round, two digits}_manifest.json.

revision.description: 1 before the round; one more each time households are moved during the round.

supersedes.description: The fingerprint of the manifest this revision replaces.

away.description: Enumerators marked as away this round.

matching.description: The leader's matching criteria and every enumerator's values: the record of how the round was assigned.

field_visits.description: Outcomes of field visits the leader recorded during the round (3 November 2026), in order; the latest for a household is written as a note on it in its enumerator's revised file.

replacement_decisions.description: The leader's decisions on replacement requests during the round (approval 'leader'), in order: a released replacement is active for the household's holder from its time.

moves.description: Households moved during the round, in order. The merge accepts the previous enumerator's dials up to the move and flags any made after it.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of that enumerator's assignment file.

platform_id.description: This enumerator's code in the program's data-collection platform (an interviewer ID, such as the L2PHL form's int_id), so that platform files are read under the tool's enumerator ID.

previous_fingerprints.description: This enumerator's earlier files in this round, oldest first; a log that started from any of them belongs to the round.

added_at.description: A household added to the round after it started: when.

matched.description: Only when the round has matching criteria: whether the enumerator matches the household.

replacements.description: The household's unused replacements, in order (IDs only).
